_why:
Files drawer honesty, before/after deck (2026-09-11). Every state is a workbench-only override of window.claude.artifacts.*; nothing real is touched. The same plan runs on master and on the branch — master renders the old wording — so both sweeps verify and the deck compares the pictures.

Two traps paid for here, both worth keeping:
1. The 'Show missing' switch is a stored preference the app reads AT STARTUP, and the rig's `pre` evals run after the app has mounted — so a shot must write the key and RELOAD, then re-install its own overrides (a reload discards the ones `pre` installed). That makes each shot independent of the shot before it and of the browser profile left over from the last run.
2. The Edit pill carries `pointer-events: none` while the file list is open, and clicking a row re-opens the list (SessionDrawer setListOpen(true)) — so a shot that wants Edit must collapse the list first with the 'Hide list' toggle. A click on an unclickable pill is silently swallowed and looks exactly like a missing button.

pre.eval: if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('mode')!=='workbench'||!new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('child')) throw new Error('Mock injection requires child workbench');

shots.name: files-one-missing
shots._why: One file is not at its saved location, with missing rows shown. Before: the row reads 'deleted' and the switch says 'Show deleted'. After: 'not found', switch 'Show missing'.

actions.eval: for(const ns of ['artifacts']){const original=window.claude[ns], overrides={};window.claude[ns]=new Proxy(original,{get:(t,k)=>Object.hasOwn(overrides,k)?overrides[k]:Reflect.get(t,k),set:(_t,k,v)=>{overrides[k]=v;return true;}});} window.seen=(...parts)=>parts.some(p=>document.body.innerText.includes(p)); window.claude.artifacts.checkExistence=(_root,ids)=>Promise.resolve({ok:true,missingIds:ids.slice(1,2)});

shots.name: files-all-missing
shots._why: Every file in the chat is missing and the switch is OFF. Before: 'Nothing here yet' — untrue. After: how many are not where they were saved, with a way to show them.

shots._why: A text file in an older encoding. After: the pane says why editing is off, and offers no Edit. Before: no note, and Edit is offered.
shots.expect: js:window.seen('older text format','Notes from the 2019 trip')

shots.name: file-save-failed
shots._why: A save the computer refuses. Before: the button does nothing at all. After: a banner naming the cause, with the draft kept. The list is collapsed first because the Edit pill ignores pointer events while it is open.

actions.eval: for(const ns of ['artifacts']){const original=window.claude[ns], overrides={};window.claude[ns]=new Proxy(original,{get:(t,k)=>Object.hasOwn(overrides,k)?overrides[k]:Reflect.get(t,k),set:(_t,k,v)=>{overrides[k]=v;return true;}});} window.seen=(...parts)=>parts.some(p=>document.body.innerText.includes(p)); window.pill=(word)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()===word&&b.className.includes('rounded-full')); window.claude.artifacts.save=()=>Promise.reject(new Error("Error invoking remote method 'artifacts:save': Error: EACCES: permission denied, open '/home/u/proj/notes.md'"));
